english_description:
Triggers every 5 seconds. On trigger, gain 1 {poision} stack and randomly gain one of the following effects for 4 seconds:
	{atk} +15%
	{attackSpeed} +10%
	{weaponRes} -10%
chinese_description:
每 5 秒觸發一次。觸發時，獲得 1 層{poision}，並隨機獲得以下一種效果，持續 4 秒：
	{atk} +15%
	{attackSpeed} +10%
	{weaponRes} -10%

english_description: Takes effect at the start of battle. Recover 3 {hp} every 1 second and encrease {toxicRes} by 10%. At the start of battle and every 3 seconds afterward, gain 1 {poision} stack.
chinese_description: 開始時生效，每 1 秒回復 3 {hp}，並使{toxicRes} +10%。開場時以及之後每 3 秒加 1 層{poision}。

english_description: Battle-wide passive. Triggers every 3 seconds. For the next 2 seconds, {weaponRes} +50%. When the effect ends, gain 1 {poision} stack and return 40% of the damage.
chinese_description: 全場被動。每 3 秒觸發一次。接下來 2 秒內，{weaponRes} +50%，但是在效果結束時獲得一層{poision}並且返還 40% 傷害。

english_description: Passive: {maxHp} gain +10%. Triggers every 4 seconds. On trigger, gain 10 {maxHp} and 1 {poision} stack. For the next 5 seconds, {attackSpeed} +20%.
chinese_description: 被動：{maxHp}獲取量 +10%。每 4 秒觸發一次。觸發時，獲得 10 {maxHp}、一層{poision}。接下來 5 秒內，{attackSpeed} +20%。

english_description: Battle-wide passive. Whenever the character reduces {poision} by 2 stacks by any means, gain 5 {shield} and +5% damage.
chinese_description: 全場被動。角色每次以任何手段減少 2 層{poision}，獲得 5 {shield} 並且傷害 +5%。

english_description: Battle-wide passive. If the character takes {poision} damage, 10% of that damage is converted into {shield}. Increases the character's natural {poision} decay speed by 20%. This effect does not apply while {poision} stacks are below 5.
chinese_description: 全場被動。如果角色因為{poision}受傷，其中的 10% 轉化為{shield}。增加「抗藥性」的{poision}衰減速度20%，此效果在{poision}層數低於 5 時不生效。

english_description:
Triggers every 4 seconds. On trigger, gain 3 {poision} stacks and randomly gain two of the following effects for 4 seconds:
	{atk} +30%
	{attackSpeed} +20%
	{allRes} +20%
	Gain 2 {shield} per second
	{toxicRes} +40%

If the same effect is rolled more than once, that effect's value is increased by 50%. For example, rolling {atk} twice results in (30% + 30%) x 1.5 = +90%.
chinese_description:
每 4 秒觸發一次。觸發時，獲得 3 層{poision}，並隨機獲得以下兩種效果，持續 4 秒：
	{atk} +30%
	{attackSpeed} +20%
	{allRes} +20%
	每秒增加 2 點{shield}
	{toxicRes} +40%

如果隨機到重複效果，該效果數值提高 50%。例如抽到兩次{atk}，最後效果是 (30% + 30%) x 1.5 = +90%。

english_description:
Triggers every 5 seconds. On trigger, gain 2 {poision} stacks. For the next 3 seconds, {attackSpeed} +30%.

While the drug effect is active, each successful attack deals a small amount of additional damage. This damage is not affected by multipliers. After the drug effect ends, {attackSpeed} -20% for 2 seconds.
chinese_description:
每 5 秒觸發一次。觸發時，獲得 2 層{poision}。接下來 3 秒內，{attackSpeed} +30%。

藥效期間，每次攻擊命中時，額外造成1點傷害（這個傷害不參加倍數計算）。藥效結束後，{attackSpeed} -20%，持續 2 秒。

english_description:
Consumed at the start of battle, gaining 6 {poision} stacks. {evasion} +20% and {hitRate} -20%.

Whenever you successfully dodge, gain 5 {shield}. Whenever an attack misses, {attackSpeed} +50% until the next successful hit.
chinese_description:
開場食用，獲得 6 層{poision}。{evasion} +20%，{hitRate} -20%。

每次成功閃避時，獲得 5 {shield}。每次攻擊落空，{attackSpeed} +50%（直到下次攻擊命中）。

english_description: Triggers every 8 seconds. On trigger, gain 20 {poision} stacks. Immediately remove 50% of current {poision} stacks. For every 10 {poision} stacks removed, increase {toxicRes} in this battle by 5%.
chinese_description: 每 8 秒觸發一次。觸發時，獲得 20 層{poision}。立刻移除目前 50% 的{poision}層數，每移除 10 層，本場戰鬥{toxicRes} +5%。

english_description: Battle-wide passive. While the character is Sober, {allRes} +15%. Whenever the character leaves Sober, gain {shield} equal to current {poision} stacks x 2.
chinese_description: 全場被動。角色清醒狀態時，{allRes} +15%。每次脫離清醒狀態的時候，獲得當前{poision}層數 x 2 的{shield}。

english_description: Battle-wide passive. Whenever the character takes 5 Poison damage, gain 1 Routine stack, up to 5 stacks. Each Routine stack increases natural Poison decay speed by 5%.
chinese_description: 全場被動。角色每受到 5 點{toxic}傷害時，獲得 1 層規律，最多 5 層。每層規律使「抗藥性」的{poision}衰減速度 +5%。

english_description:
Triggers every 9 seconds. On trigger, gain 20 {poision} stacks. For the next 5 seconds, {atk} +25%, {attackSpeed} +25%, and attacks gain 50% lifesteal.

After the drug effect ends, lose 20% of current {hp} plus 10% of {maxHp}.
chinese_description:
每 9 秒觸發一次。觸發時，獲得 20 層{poision}。接下來 5 秒內，{atk} +25%，{attackSpeed} +25%，並且攻擊增加 50% 吸血。

藥效結束後，失去目前{hp}的 20% + {maxHp}的 10%。

english_description:
Triggers every 8 seconds. For the next 5 seconds, {attackSpeed} +50%.

While the drug effect is active, gain 1 Overclock stack after each attack. Each Overclock stack further increases {attackSpeed} by 5%, up to 10 stacks. After the drug effect ends, clear all Overclock stacks and enter Neural Burn for 3 seconds. During Neural Burn, each attack grants 2 {poision} stacks.
chinese_description:
每 8 秒觸發一次。接下來 5 秒內，{attackSpeed} +50%。

藥效期間，每次攻擊後，額外獲得 1 層超頻。每層超頻使{attackSpeed}再 +5%，最多 10 層。藥效結束後，清除所有超頻，並進入神經燒灼 3 秒。神經燒灼期間，每次攻擊獲得兩層{poision}。

english_description:
Triggers every 7 seconds. On trigger, gain 5 {poision} stacks. For the next 4 seconds, {hitRate} -50% and {critRate} +50%.

While the drug effect is active, each miss increases {critRate} by another 5%. After the drug effect ends, enter Whiteout Vision for 2 seconds. During Whiteout Vision, {missRate} increased by 25%.
chinese_description:
每 7 秒觸發一次。觸發時，獲得 5 層{poision}。接下來 4 秒內，{hitRate} -50%，{critRate} +50%。

藥效期間，每次 miss 都會讓{critRate}再加上 5%。藥效結束後，進入白化視界 2 秒。白化視界期間，{hitRate}降低25%。

english_description:
Passive effect. Automatically triggers when the character takes fatal damage. Can trigger only once per battle.

On trigger, gain 150 {poision} stacks and gain an effect that reduces {poision} by 50 stacks per second. The character cannot die until {poision} returns to 0. All attacks deal additional damage.

When the drug effect ends, if the enemy is still alive, the character dies immediately.
chinese_description:
被動效果。角色受到致命傷害時自動觸發。每場戰鬥只能觸發一次。

觸發時，獲得 150 層{poision}，獲得每秒降低 50 層{poision}的效果。接下來角色無法死亡，直到{poision}回到 0 結束。所有攻擊附帶4點額外傷害。

藥效結束時，如果敵人仍然存活，角色直接死亡。

english_description:
Battle-wide passive. While Sober, all non-weapon equipment triggers 50% faster. Whenever the character's {poision} stacks exceed 20, enter Ward.

During Ward:
	Force Sober.
	The character loses 10 {poision} stacks per second.
	For every 10 {poision} stacks reduced during this time, lose HP equal to 5% of {maxHp}.
	If {poision} reaches 0 during this time, Ward lingers for 1 second before ending.

While Sober, {allRes} +15%. Whenever the character leaves Sober, reduce {maxHp} by 10% and immediately reduce {poision} stacks by an equal amount. If there are no {poision} stacks to reduce, gain Antidote stacks, causing the next N {poision} stacks to be nullified.
chinese_description: 清醒狀態{allRes} +15%。每次角色脫離清醒狀態，降低 10% {maxHp}，立刻減少等量的{poision}層數，若無層數可減，獲得解毒劑層數（使接下來 N 層{poision}失效）。

english_description: Whenever an attack misses, gain 1 Chip. On a critical hit, cash in all Chips. Each Chip increases that attack's damage by 10%. Hold up to 5 Chips.
chinese_description: 攻擊未命中時，獲得 1 枚籌碼。爆擊時兌現全部籌碼，每枚使該次攻擊的傷害增加 10%。最多持有 5 枚。

english_description: Critical damage +40%, but each critical hit consumes 1 additional {stamina}. If there is not enough {stamina}, the damage bonus does not apply.
chinese_description: 爆擊傷害 +40%，但每次爆擊額外消耗 1 點{stamina}。{stamina}不足時，不獲得傷害加成。

english_description: After more than 2 consecutive misses, each attack refunds 25% of its {stamina} cost until an attack hits.
chinese_description: 連續未命中超過 2 次後，每次攻擊返還 25% 的{stamina}消耗，直到攻擊命中為止。

english_description: When an attack with less than 40% {hitRate} hits, recover 1 {stamina}.
chinese_description: {hitRate}低於 40% 的攻擊一旦命中，回復 1 點{stamina}。

english_description: Each miss increases the current damage bonus in sequence to 10%, 20%, 40%, 80%, and 160%. Clear the bonus when an attack hits. If that attack is not a critical hit, only half of the damage bonus applies.
chinese_description: 每次未命中，使目前的傷害加成依序增加至 10%、20%、40%、80%、160%。命中時清空加成；若該次攻擊沒有爆擊，只獲得一半的傷害加成。

english_description: Each miss increases the next attack's damage and {stamina} cost by 20%. This effect stacks and is cleared when an attack hits.
chinese_description: 每次未命中，使下一次攻擊的傷害與{stamina}消耗增加 20%。效果可以疊加，命中後清空。

english_description: After every 3 consecutive misses, recover 40% of missing {hp}.
chinese_description: 每連續未命中 3 次時，回復已失去{hp}的 40%。

english_description: After 3 consecutive attacks hit, repeat the last attack 10 times. Each repeated attack deals 10% damage and consumes no {stamina}. The repeated attack primarily refers to the equipped weapon's attack.
chinese_description: 連續命中 3 次攻擊時，連續觸發 10 次最後一次攻擊（主要指使用的武器）；每次造成 10% 傷害，且不消耗{stamina}。

english_description: Gain 1 Mark stack with each attack. At 4 or more stacks, consume 4 stacks when an attack misses to force it to hit. After this triggers, there is a 50% chance to reduce your critical damage by 50% for 5 seconds.
chinese_description: 每次攻擊累積 1 層記號。持有至少 4 層時，可在攻擊未命中時消耗 4 層，強制使該次攻擊變為命中。觸發後有 50% 機率使自身的爆擊傷害降低 50%，持續 5 秒。

english_description: When attempting to use a weapon without enough {stamina}, remove 1 stack of your highest-grade Curse. 5-second cooldown.
chinese_description: 使用武器但{stamina}不足時，移除 1 層自身最高等級 Curse 的效果。冷卻時間 5 秒。

english_description: When taking damage, there is a 50% chance to halve that damage.
chinese_description: 受到傷害時，有 50% 機率使該次傷害減半。

english_description: Resolve the results after every 3 attacks. If all 3 results are identical, gain a reward: 3 misses immediately trigger Hot Hand (Passive 3) 9 times; 3 critical hits immediately perform 7 attacks without consuming {stamina}.
chinese_description: 每 3 次攻擊結算一次。3 次攻擊結果完全相同時獲得獎勵：3 次未命中，使「手氣正旺」（被動 3）立刻觸發 9 次；3 次爆擊，則立刻進行 7 次不消耗{stamina}的攻擊。

english_description: Each miss grants 1-6 points. A critical hit clears all points; the more points held, the higher that critical hit's damage (damage multiplier = 1.1 + 3.9 x ((points - 1) / 20)^2, ranging from 1.1 to 5). If points exceed 21, immediately clear them and recover 10% of {maxHp}.
chinese_description: 每次未命中獲得 1～6 點。爆擊時清空點數；點數越高，該次爆擊傷害越高（傷害倍率 = 1.1 + 3.9 × ((點數 − 1) ÷ 20)²，範圍為 1.1～5）。點數超過 21 時，立即清空點數並回復 10% {maxHp}。

english_description: When {hp} reaches 0, do not die immediately. Clear all {critRate} (X) accumulated by Hot Hand (Passive 3) during this battle, then perform an attack with 200% lifesteal. This attack is guaranteed to hit and its damage is multiplied by X. Can trigger only once per battle.
chinese_description: {hp}降至 0 時不直接死亡。清除「手氣正旺」（被動 3）在本場戰鬥累積的所有{critRate}（X），並發動一次具有 200% 吸血的攻擊；該次攻擊必定命中，且傷害乘以 X。每場戰鬥只能觸發一次。

english_description: Whenever an attack misses, record 50% of that attack's base damage. Each attack that hits has a 7% chance to hit the jackpot, making it guaranteed to hit and adding all previously recorded damage to its base damage. Clear the recorded damage afterward.
chinese_description: 每次未命中時，記錄該次攻擊基礎傷害的 50%。命中的攻擊有 7% 機率中獎，使該次攻擊必定命中，且其基礎傷害加入先前記錄的所有傷害；之後清空記錄。

english_description: Attacks can still be performed without enough {stamina}. For every 0.5 missing {stamina}, lose 5% of {maxHp} and add base damage equal to the {hp} lost to that attack.
chinese_description: {stamina}不足時仍可發動攻擊。每缺少 0.5 點{stamina}，便失去 5% {maxHp}，並使該次攻擊增加等同於所失去{hp}的基礎傷害。

english_description: {maxHp} +10%. Recover 0.5 {hp} per second.
chinese_description: {maxHp} +10%。每秒回復 0.5 {hp}。

english_description: {maxStamina} +20%. {stamina} recovery +0.5 per second.
chinese_description: {maxStamina} +20%。{stamina}回復速度每秒 +0.5。

english_description: {weaponRes} +10%. {attackSpeed} +5%.
chinese_description: {weaponRes} +10%。{attackSpeed} +5%。

english_description: The first time {stamina} reaches 0 in each battle, immediately recover 2 {stamina}.
chinese_description: 每場戰鬥第一次{stamina}降至 0 時，立即回復 2 點{stamina}。

english_description: For every 50 damage taken, recover 1 {stamina}.
chinese_description: 每受到 50 點傷害，回復 1 點{stamina}。

english_description: Every third attack consumes no {stamina}.
chinese_description: 每第 3 次攻擊不消耗{stamina}。

english_description: When {stamina} reaches 0, immediately recover all {stamina}. 12-second cooldown.
chinese_description: {stamina}降至 0 時，立即回復全部{stamina}。冷卻時間 12 秒。

english_description: While {hp} is below 50%, recover 5 additional {stamina} per second.
chinese_description: {hp}低於 50% 時，{stamina}回復速度每秒 +5。

english_description: While {hp} is at or below 25%, damage taken -50% and weapon damage -50%.
chinese_description: {hp}不高於 25% 時，受到的傷害 -50%，武器攻擊力 -50%。

english_description: Attacks gain 50% lifesteal.
chinese_description: 攻擊吸血 +50%。

english_description: Recover 2.5% of {maxHp} per second. This effect becomes stronger as {hp} decreases, up to 5% of {maxHp} per second.
chinese_description: 每秒回復 2.5% {maxHp}。{hp}越低時效果越強，最高每秒回復 5% {maxHp}。
